title: Heart ASCII Art ♥ Copy & Paste
meta_description: Copy and paste heart ASCII art — original multi-line heart pictures drawn in plain characters, from a tiny one-line <3 to big solid and outline hearts.
hero_tagline: Original heart pictures drawn entirely in plain text: one-line hearts, small hearts, and big multi-line pieces. Click Copy on any card.
intro: Heart ASCII art draws a heart shape entirely out of keyboard characters: from the two-keystroke classic <3 to large multi-line hearts built from asterisks, colons, and slashes. One-line hearts paste cleanly anywhere; the bigger multi-line pieces keep their shape only where text renders in a fixed-width (monospace) font, such as Discord code blocks, terminals, and plain-text editors. Every piece below is an original drawing. Click Copy to grab it with its line breaks and spacing intact.
